10e9503993db57ca89c106b32b20c7981ad2570e.source: 视频教程：<s id="0">观看本章视频</s>。
10e9503993db57ca89c106b32b20c7981ad2570e.translation: Video tutorial: <s id="0">watch this chapter's video</s>.

2c97e6931008eb17e751c33c022998c2b5a22811.source: 从 WAV 提取基频、共振峰、发声和唇形参数，保存为表格，再到参数显示看曲线。先用一份短录音试好设置，再处理整批会更省心。
2c97e6931008eb17e751c33c022998c2b5a22811.translation: Extract fundamental frequency, formants, phonation, and lip parameters from WAV files, save them as tables, and view the curves in Parameter display. Try the settings on a short recording before processing the entire batch.

4f04a041aeb56bca258ec4cb0169a445a8a18322.source: 准备 WAV。本机支持<s id="0">最长 30 分钟、2 GB、8–192 kHz、1–8 声道</s>，保留原录音。
4f04a041aeb56bca258ec4cb0169a445a8a18322.translation: Prepare WAV files. Local processing supports <s id="0">up to 30 minutes, 2 GB, 8–192 kHz, and 1–8 channels</s>. Keep the original recordings.

1a308da2e4a3ac06f82901b1e1823ea80f6d6361.source: 点击顶部<s id="0">打开音频目录</s>。需要读取下层目录时勾选<s id="1">包含子文件夹</s>，左栏会显示相对路径。
1a308da2e4a3ac06f82901b1e1823ea80f6d6361.translation: Click <s id="0">Open audio folder</s> at the top. To include nested folders, enable <s id="1">Include subfolders</s>; relative paths appear in the left panel.

6c1d291bfd3b26e3516afd3494991fb07884f797.source: 已载入 WAV 的参数估计工作台：顶部目录栏、左侧文件列表、中央波形和右侧任务记录。
6c1d291bfd3b26e3516afd3494991fb07884f797.translation: Parameter estimation with WAV loaded: folder controls at the top, files on the left, waveform in the centre, and task records on the right.

355fe0a7f25fb0ad650db95399f4af31e6d9f8a3.source: 最大化的 V3 参数估计界面，左侧已选一份单音节 WAV，中央显示真实波形，右侧显示全列表与选中文件分析按钮及已完成任务。
355fe0a7f25fb0ad650db95399f4af31e6d9f8a3.translation: Maximized V3 Parameter estimation with a monosyllabic WAV selected on the left, its actual waveform in the centre, and full-list/selected-file analysis buttons and completed tasks on the right.

eac4000e5ad8435b4177b1b9e7c7419df24a84c1.source: 新增或更换文件后点<s id="0">刷新列表</s>。取消目录选择会保留原目录。
eac4000e5ad8435b4177b1b9e7c7419df24a84c1.translation: After adding or replacing files, click <s id="0">Refresh list</s>. Cancelling folder selection retains the previous folder.

c05863af9ca684f2569971839a3f1bfecc184776.source: TextGrid 和唇形可选：同名 IntervalTier 型 <s id="0">.TextGrid</s>、<s id="1">.lip.json</s> 默认自动关联，本机也能受限读取旧数值 .pkl。
c05863af9ca684f2569971839a3f1bfecc184776.translation: TextGrid and lip data are optional. Same-name IntervalTier <s id="0">.TextGrid</s> and <s id="1">.lip.json</s> files are linked automatically by default. Local processing can also read legacy numeric .pkl files under restricted conditions.

d6063a341b87ceaa79f384384e6284e835959de6.source: 另放文件时点<s id="0">选择TextGrid目录</s>或<s id="1">选择唇形目录</s>。旁边的<s id="2">重置</s>让它重新跟随音频目录。
d6063a341b87ceaa79f384384e6284e835959de6.translation: For files stored elsewhere, click <s id="0">Select TextGrid folder</s> or <s id="1">Select lip folder</s>. The adjacent <s id="2">Reset</s> returns that association to the audio folder.

8ebeded6cc866316028b5d32213ba1dff3746f8f.source: 默认<s id="0">结果与WAV同目录</s>。想集中保存，取消勾选后点<s id="1">选择结果目录</s>，确认位置和剩余空间。
8ebeded6cc866316028b5d32213ba1dff3746f8f.translation: <s id="0">Save results beside WAV</s> is enabled by default. To collect results in one place, disable it, click <s id="1">Select results folder</s>, and check the location and free space.

6b1cca418f7436e617d1a55e6776f822a21fd775.source: 项目网页版先在文件管理中上传素材，再回来刷新。点击<s id="0">添加WAV到列表</s>即可试听 WAV。
6b1cca418f7436e617d1a55e6776f822a21fd775.translation: In a web project, upload materials through file management first, then return and refresh. Click <s id="0">Add WAV to list</s> to preview WAV audio.

19a0f633a740a11c5916d28c56bc0da83567252f.source: 顶部<s id="0">帮助</s>可随时打开本章，左侧目录直接跳到需要的步骤，<s id="1">返回</s>回到工作台。
19a0f633a740a11c5916d28c56bc0da83567252f.translation: The top <s id="0">Help</s> button opens this chapter at any time. Use the contents on the left to jump to a step, and <s id="1">Back</s> to return to the workbench.

8d33b28b24a9e084d6fb4de88e9cbac95910310b.source: 点击左栏<s id="0">文件名</s>，中央显示波形、采样率、声道和时长。读取失败时先检查 WAV 是否可解码、内容是否改变。
8d33b28b24a9e084d6fb4de88e9cbac95910310b.translation: Click a <s id="0">file name</s> on the left to show its waveform, sample rate, channels, and duration. If loading fails, first check that the WAV can be decoded and that its contents have not changed.

5638935f66e90d0c7289a0d165185eea2be725b2.source: 核对中央的<s id="0">TextGrid</s>和<s id="1">唇形数据</s>下拉框。出现<s id="2">关联待确认</s>时手动选准文件，不需要的关联选<s id="3">不关联</s>。
5638935f66e90d0c7289a0d165185eea2be725b2.translation: Check the central <s id="0">TextGrid</s> and <s id="1">Lip data</s> selectors. If <s id="2">Association needs confirmation</s> appears, select the correct file manually. Choose <s id="3">No association</s> for links you do not need.

b58fe5b85fc391b9eff7d139c0781d71e296ec66.source: 选择<s id="0">试听声道</s>，拖选波形或填写底部起止时间，再点<s id="1">播放选区</s>。用<s id="2">停止</s>结束播放。
b58fe5b85fc391b9eff7d139c0781d71e296ec66.translation: Select a <s id="0">Playback channel</s>, drag across the waveform or enter start/end times below, and click <s id="1">Play selection</s>. End playback with <s id="2">Stop</s>.

7967d45be348a4fde0aa379ce4c4915bf9e59e60.source: <s id="0">点文件名用于预览；勾选复选框才会选入分析范围。</s> 试听范围由选区控制，分析始终读取完整 WAV。
7967d45be348a4fde0aa379ce4c4915bf9e59e60.translation: <s id="0">Clicking a file name previews it; checking its checkbox includes it in analysis.</s> The selection controls playback, while analysis always reads the complete WAV.

f75a230f335672b2f5bc8ade5d92c2fe196606e6.source: 选择参数、设置并开始分析
f75a230f335672b2f5bc8ade5d92c2fe196606e6.translation: Choose parameters and settings, then start analysis

6e3e15b39e12849d737d4987dca82bbc6ba16bbc.source: 点左栏<s id="0">选择输出参数</s>。新草稿默认 80 项全选，可搜索名称或参数键；首次试算可先选 <s id="1">pF0</s>、<s id="2">rF0</s>、<s id="3">Intensity</s>。
6e3e15b39e12849d737d4987dca82bbc6ba16bbc.translation: Click <s id="0">Select output parameters</s> on the left. New drafts select all 80 parameters by default; search by name or parameter key. For a first test, try <s id="1">pF0</s>, <s id="2">rF0</s>, and <s id="3">Intensity</s>.

f66ef9f381c5384cf8ed3f5f3ac4b7492d23e961.source: 核对已选数量，点<s id="0">应用到草稿</s>。至少选一项才能应用，<s id="1">取消</s>放弃弹窗中的改动。
f66ef9f381c5384cf8ed3f5f3ac4b7492d23e961.translation: Check the selected count and click <s id="0">Apply to draft</s>. At least one parameter is required. <s id="1">Cancel</s> discards changes made in the dialog.

4e68ddec0275b53edaff2eb6f39743d97f5c8a8f.source: 输出参数初始全选状态：80项全部勾选，可按本次研究需要缩减。
4e68ddec0275b53edaff2eb6f39743d97f5c8a8f.translation: Initial output selection: all 80 parameters checked, ready to reduce for the current study.

2bd03b3a67e05c6c7f1eb8be4304d7600ea6c0b9.source: 最大化V3输出参数弹窗，已选数量为80/80，四列列表显示参数名称和稳定键，右下为应用到草稿。
2bd03b3a67e05c6c7f1eb8be4304d7600ea6c0b9.translation: Maximized V3 output-parameter dialog, showing 80/80 selected, names and stable keys in four columns, and Apply to draft at the lower right.

85b0f2153da4900f3d77f2e84c6a482b951af342.source: <s id="0">搜索只筛选显示，隐藏的勾选仍保留。</s> <s id="1">全选／全不选</s>都作用于完整的 80 项。
85b0f2153da4900f3d77f2e84c6a482b951af342.translation: <s id="0">Search only filters the display; hidden selections remain checked.</s> <s id="1">Select all / Deselect all</s> both affect the complete set of 80 parameters.

0969948402be22d9235b61502d62f16082fdaa32.source: 例如搜索 <s id="0">H1H2</s>，只显示四项。若原来全选，计数仍是 80/80；要只算这四项，先点<s id="1">全不选</s>再逐项勾选。
0969948402be22d9235b61502d62f16082fdaa32.translation: For example, searching <s id="0">H1H2</s> displays four items. If all were selected, the count remains 80/80. To compute only those four, click <s id="1">Deselect all</s>, then check each one.

69a52337a9ee7841dbe4720b74105974652bf72e.source: 按H1H2筛选后仅显示四项，原有80项勾选继续保留。
69a52337a9ee7841dbe4720b74105974652bf72e.translation: Filtering by H1H2 shows four items while retaining all 80 existing selections.

00fc4ceabfd9325251b52c02f901eb2294faa0e1.source: 最大化V3参数筛选弹窗，搜索H1H2后显示Praat/REAPER与修正/未修正四项，已选数量仍为80/80。
00fc4ceabfd9325251b52c02f901eb2294faa0e1.translation: Maximized V3 filter dialog after searching H1H2, showing Praat/REAPER and corrected/uncorrected variants. The selected count remains 80/80.

5ccea081c29425ba8083b513cd77e4ff16b0a8a6.source: 0/80 时<s id="0">应用到草稿</s>不可用。勾选至少一项，或点<s id="1">取消</s>返回原选择。
5ccea081c29425ba8083b513cd77e4ff16b0a8a6.translation: At 0/80, <s id="0">Apply to draft</s> is disabled. Select at least one item or click <s id="1">Cancel</s> to restore the previous selection.

5f1de2893381568848baf0f91d69a0b072c5b0a8.source: 全不选状态：勾选至少一项输出参数后可应用到草稿。
5f1de2893381568848baf0f91d69a0b072c5b0a8.translation: All parameters deselected: check at least one output parameter before applying to the draft.

d28cdf7e12dfb4226314f8054b79b023cf201eb2.source: 最大化V3输出参数弹窗显示0/80，所有复选框为空，应用到草稿按钮禁用。
d28cdf7e12dfb4226314f8054b79b023cf201eb2.translation: Maximized V3 output-parameter dialog at 0/80, with all boxes empty and Apply to draft disabled.

00ba830b67c2a4e158fc09a5ece95417f119ee27.source: 清空搜索后可在全目录选择。例如勾选 <s id="0">pF0</s>、<s id="1">pF1</s>、<s id="2">pF2</s>，计数应为 3/80，应用后左栏也会显示三项。
00ba830b67c2a4e158fc09a5ece95417f119ee27.translation: Clear the search to select from the full catalogue. For example, check <s id="0">pF0</s>, <s id="1">pF1</s>, and <s id="2">pF2</s>; the count should be 3/80. After applying, the left panel also shows three items.

2d1414da8923ac4460398101c23220b906ac768f.source: 输出参数弹窗：按名称或参数键筛选，核对勾选数量后应用到草稿。
2d1414da8923ac4460398101c23220b906ac768f.translation: Output-parameter dialog: filter by name or key, check the count, then apply to the draft.

8dab7628588b8a3a09960edd9c5eedcf71db1a06.source: 最大化的 V3 工作台打开输出参数弹窗，顶部有搜索、全选和全不选，当前勾选三项，右下角显示应用到草稿。
8dab7628588b8a3a09960edd9c5eedcf71db1a06.translation: Maximized V3 workbench with the output-parameter dialog open. Search, Select all, and Deselect all are at the top; three items are selected, with Apply to draft at the lower right.

928c6a287e1036735ff5086e493212c0f8090d16.source: 在<s id="0">编辑14项设置</s>中调整数值，再点<s id="1">应用设置</s>。
928c6a287e1036735ff5086e493212c0f8090d16.translation: Adjust values in <s id="0">Edit 14 settings</s>, then click <s id="1">Apply settings</s>.

611735df2b686b8affc07140b73ea94b9bf68baf.source: 想下次沿用这些参数和设置，点顶部<s id="0">保存草稿</s>，等待保存提示。
611735df2b686b8affc07140b73ea94b9bf68baf.translation: To reuse the parameters and settings next time, click <s id="0">Save draft</s> at the top and wait for the confirmation.

96fc3971c0f36c7ce5a62a540037e6445909cafb.source: 已提交的任务沿用原设置，修改只影响下一次提交。
96fc3971c0f36c7ce5a62a540037e6445909cafb.translation: Submitted tasks retain their original settings. Edits affect only the next submission.

6230ac23297f050df816adc0f4c989c04669159f.source: 草稿只记参数、设置和默认声道／EGG选项。<s id="0">目录、原文件和逐文件声道选择不会保存</s>，重新进入后要再选目录并核对接线。
6230ac23297f050df816adc0f4c989c04669159f.translation: Drafts store parameters, settings, and default channel / EGG options only. <s id="0">Folders, original files, and per-file channel choices are not saved.</s> On reopening, select folders and check connections again.

79146af0c8ed03b88ba889d51c1636c296bb4b29.source: 点编辑14项设置，在常用设置 · 12检查帧移、分析窗、阈值、平滑和最小／最大基频。新草稿默认帧移 5 ms、分析窗 40 ms，F0 范围 30–800 Hz；旧草稿沿用已保存值。基频上下限同时影响 Praat、REAPER、WM 链及部分依赖 F0 的指标，与共振峰上限分别设置。详细范围见后面的速查表。
79146af0c8ed03b88ba889d51c1636c296bb4b29.translation: Click Edit 14 settings. Under Common settings · 12, check frame step, analysis window, thresholds, smoothing, and minimum/maximum fundamental frequency. New drafts default to a 5 ms frame step, a 40 ms analysis window, and an F0 range of 30–800 Hz; older drafts retain saved values. Fundamental frequency bounds affect Praat, REAPER, the WM chain, and some F0-dependent measures, and are separate from the formant ceiling. See the reference table below for detailed ranges.

2b5601840ef446d8d5839c34bfeeccc80597fc52.source: 常用设置页：12 项共用设置，包含最小基频和最大基频。
2b5601840ef446d8d5839c34bfeeccc80597fc52.translation: Common settings: 12 shared settings, including minimum and maximum fundamental frequency.

082bdce1de6fa435a1164747192631c93bc90c2b.source: 最大化的 V3 工作台打开分析设置常用设置页，包含 12 项设置，最小基频 30 Hz、最大基频 800 Hz。
082bdce1de6fa435a1164747192631c93bc90c2b.translation: Maximized V3 Common settings page with 12 settings, minimum fundamental frequency 30 Hz and maximum 800 Hz.

daa9935f66478ebae4bf7a41f05d3fbd50b0a400.source: 在常用设置中，最小基频必须小于最大基频。例如填成 900–800 Hz，会提示错误并留在弹窗，尚未应用。
daa9935f66478ebae4bf7a41f05d3fbd50b0a400.translation: In Common settings, minimum fundamental frequency must be below maximum. Entering 900–800 Hz, for example, shows an error and keeps the dialog open without applying changes.

405a8c0cfe3ddb684ad77a86c1c5cbc870fc65f7.source: 最小基频高于最大基频时，应用设置被校验阻止并保留弹窗。
405a8c0cfe3ddb684ad77a86c1c5cbc870fc65f7.translation: If minimum fundamental frequency exceeds maximum, validation blocks Apply settings and retains the dialog.

bb2e538018a7b60858dda3ab76f58933db2c4a53.source: 最大化V3分析设置的常用设置页，最小基频900Hz、最大800Hz，下方提示最小基频必须小于最大基频。
bb2e538018a7b60858dda3ab76f58933db2c4a53.translation: Maximized V3 Common settings page with minimum fundamental frequency 900 Hz and maximum 800 Hz; the message below requires minimum to be below maximum.

60cbbfac2e12d4af639d74f3d9078b9be2e4b2c4.source: 先核对最小和最大基频，范围错误时修正后再提交。
60cbbfac2e12d4af639d74f3d9078b9be2e4b2c4.translation: Check both fundamental-frequency bounds first. Correct an invalid range before submitting.

9d163837d8b10ceda3ec6fbf761c237eb42e719b.source: 修正两端数值后重新点<s id="0">应用设置</s>，或点<s id="1">取消</s>放弃修改。
9d163837d8b10ceda3ec6fbf761c237eb42e719b.translation: Correct the bounds and click <s id="0">Apply settings</s> again, or <s id="1">Cancel</s> to discard the changes.

b421bda8668ee2cde7b82389eec919c51d23600e.source: 切到REAPER设置 · 2，包含 REAPER Hilbert变换和禁用REAPER高通滤波两个开关。默认启用 Hilbert 变换，禁用高通开关默认关闭，即仍使用高通滤波。核对后点应用设置。切换页签保留尚未应用的输入，取消放弃本次修改。
b421bda8668ee2cde7b82389eec919c51d23600e.translation: Switch to REAPER settings · 2 for the REAPER Hilbert transform and Disable REAPER high-pass filter switches. Hilbert is enabled by default; Disable high-pass is off, so high-pass filtering remains active. Check the settings and click Apply settings. Switching tabs retains unapplied input; Cancel discards this edit.

5ce1d5c722c946807a6978a84eb2edf2674e36f7.source: REAPER 设置页：仅含 Hilbert 变换和禁用高通滤波两个开关。
5ce1d5c722c946807a6978a84eb2edf2674e36f7.translation: REAPER settings: only the Hilbert-transform and Disable high-pass switches.

fe192072b3bfbbf7a34df1e9f119153687219f9e.source: 最大化的 V3 工作台打开 REAPER 设置页，仅含两个预处理开关，Hilbert 已勾选、禁用高通未勾选。
fe192072b3bfbbf7a34df1e9f119153687219f9e.translation: Maximized V3 REAPER settings page with two preprocessing switches: Hilbert checked and Disable high-pass unchecked.

bb13ecb7f2ebd05f5da55a0367d3e12245021cc3.source: REAPER 的两个开关各自控制一种预处理，勾选前核对标签。
bb13ecb7f2ebd05f5da55a0367d3e12245021cc3.translation: Each REAPER switch controls a different preprocessing step. Check its label before enabling it.

9229fcecf1d23948d5c7763b6d2e73b6900a74f0.source: 弹窗关闭后，左栏更新帧移和分析窗摘要。<s id="0">应用设置</s>用于本次分析，<s id="1">保存草稿</s>用于下次进入时恢复。
9229fcecf1d23948d5c7763b6d2e73b6900a74f0.translation: After closing the dialog, the left panel updates its frame-step and analysis-window summary. <s id="0">Apply settings</s> affects the current analysis; <s id="1">Save draft</s> restores them on a later visit.

ca7eca2e8fb70f75f0aed9fdfb43adfff3addf69.source: 选择范围、提交并检查结果
ca7eca2e8fb70f75f0aed9fdfb43adfff3addf69.translation: Choose a scope, submit, and check results

8ca5f45e37e15a84e49c6cfc365318b18df72549.source: 先看左栏<s id="0">已选数量</s>。没有勾选时，<s id="1">分析选中文件</s>不可用，<s id="2">开始全列表分析</s>仍可处理全部 WAV。
8ca5f45e37e15a84e49c6cfc365318b18df72549.translation: First check the <s id="0">selected count</s> on the left. With no checkboxes selected, <s id="1">Analyse selected files</s> is disabled, but <s id="2">Analyse entire list</s> can still process every WAV.

acb0cac2d904c01fc1a2d12e0f594224e170ac05.source: 列表有三份WAV但尚未勾选：全列表分析可用，分析选中文件不可用。
acb0cac2d904c01fc1a2d12e0f594224e170ac05.translation: Three WAV files with none checked: full-list analysis is available; selected-file analysis is disabled.

e489e5e901c21b77d45f11cc7299e4c8e82eeae0.source: 最大化V3工作台左侧三份授权样例均未勾选，右侧全列表按钮可用、分析选中文件按钮禁用。
e489e5e901c21b77d45f11cc7299e4c8e82eeae0.translation: Maximized V3 workbench with three authorized sample WAVs unchecked on the left; full-list analysis is available on the right and selected-file analysis is disabled.

f5790bbfe74b218a4c5a5e1420db6e63bf9827a1.source: 确认结果目录、文件关联和分析声道。普通录音保持<s id="0">联合计算 EGG</s>关闭。
f5790bbfe74b218a4c5a5e1420db6e63bf9827a1.translation: Check the results folder, associations, and analysis channel. For ordinary recordings, leave <s id="0">Compute EGG jointly</s> disabled.

d72c0818c11493d36d9cc1fe76af48451facbff0.source: 只算一份或几份：勾选文件，再点<s id="0">分析选中文件</s>。算全部：点<s id="1">开始全列表分析</s>，不受勾选数量影响。
d72c0818c11493d36d9cc1fe76af48451facbff0.translation: For one or a few files, check them and click <s id="0">Analyse selected files</s>. For everything, click <s id="1">Analyse entire list</s>, regardless of the selected count.

6b659f5e36c0b706d367711d628408059d6d0594.source: 右栏显示当前文件、阶段和整批状态。完成后核对顶部保存提示，到结果目录确认 .xlsx 和 <s id="0">.ptb.sqlite</s>。有失败项时按提示处理，成功项仍可保存。
6b659f5e36c0b706d367711d628408059d6d0594.translation: The right panel shows the current file, stage, and batch status. When finished, check the save notice above and confirm .xlsx and <s id="0">.ptb.sqlite</s> in the results folder. Follow the instructions for failed items; successful items can still be saved.

4da6b1a6a764d03cb648d9bcdd53c71f65640763.source: 单文件分析已完成并保存：三项输出参数、单文件 100% 进度和两份结果文件提示。
4da6b1a6a764d03cb648d9bcdd53c71f65640763.translation: Single-file analysis completed and saved: three output parameters, 100% file progress, and a notice for two result files.

c29e56a3dc3f04aa8151b603a33d99e9eb8593bd.source: 最大化的 V3 参数估计界面，一份单音节 WAV 已勾选，左侧输出参数为三项，右侧进度 100%，顶部提示已保存两份结果文件。
c29e56a3dc3f04aa8151b603a33d99e9eb8593bd.translation: Maximized V3 Parameter estimation with a monosyllabic WAV checked, three output parameters on the left, 100% progress on the right, and two result files saved according to the top notice.

e0fa48a924559714bdee10fa654db7c05c7c929c.source: 例子中左栏只勾选一份，点全列表后仍完成三份 WAV：右栏 3/3，顶部保存六份文件。每份录音各有一份 XLSX 和 SQLite。
e0fa48a924559714bdee10fa654db7c05c7c929c.translation: In this example, only one file is checked, but full-list analysis still completes all three WAVs: the right shows 3/3 and the top reports six saved files. Each recording produces an XLSX and a SQLite file.

692a177179c0f59f97fda5baa83308ca05fefc17.source: 仅勾选一份WAV仍完成全列表三份分析，批次3/3并保存六份结果。
692a177179c0f59f97fda5baa83308ca05fefc17.translation: With only one WAV checked, all three still finish in full-list analysis: batch 3/3 and six saved results.

9dab8f9145801e50bab0a84091a264119aa136a6.source: 最大化V3工作台左侧三份WAV中一份勾选，右侧当前全列表记录显示三份全部完成，顶部提示保存六个结果文件。
9dab8f9145801e50bab0a84091a264119aa136a6.translation: Maximized V3 workbench with one of three WAVs checked on the left; the full-list record on the right shows all three completed, and the top reports six saved files.

d39c1c262a62551fb9664d6580f813b643892196.source: 要再导出，选择对应<s id="0">处理记录</s>，点<s id="1">保存已完成结果</s>。这会保存已有结果，不重新计算。
d39c1c262a62551fb9664d6580f813b643892196.translation: To export again, select the relevant <s id="0">Processing record</s> and click <s id="1">Save completed results</s>. This saves existing results without recomputation.

28fa7002cc8a68b5e7dc62930b5ae682d1f7a7d9.source: 把同名标注和唇形文件放好，点<s id="0">刷新列表</s>。递归目录按相同相对路径对应。
28fa7002cc8a68b5e7dc62930b5ae682d1f7a7d9.translation: Place same-name annotation and lip files appropriately and click <s id="0">Refresh list</s>. Recursive folders match by the same relative path.

e77a219cce4c947142a78a7ca8efb577a896f238.source: 关联文件分开存放时，选择相应独立目录。更换该目录会重新匹配这一类文件。
e77a219cce4c947142a78a7ca8efb577a896f238.translation: If associated files are stored separately, choose the corresponding independent folder. Changing it rematches that type of file.

f1ed917c4eaf0063657527d782d507af98f7d871.source: 点击每份 WAV，在中央下拉框核对关联。一个文件的选择只影响它自己。
f1ed917c4eaf0063657527d782d507af98f7d871.translation: Click each WAV and check its associations in the central selectors. A file's selection affects that file only.

fe8ef436db5ac800f264476d1722af7e4574d75f.source: 遇到多个同名候选，手动选准确文件后再提交。
fe8ef436db5ac800f264476d1722af7e4574d75f.translation: If several same-name candidates exist, manually select the correct file before submitting.

e10d51d3f6d7c7e5db7ed1ff6c3efcc377f677ce.source: 补充唇形文件后可点<s id="0">关联唇形</s>批量匹配。优先 <s id="1">.lip.json</s>，<s id="2">_timestamps.pkl</s> 只作时间伴随文件。
e10d51d3f6d7c7e5db7ed1ff6c3efcc377f677ce.translation: After adding lip files, click <s id="0">Associate lip data</s> to match them in bulk. <s id="1">.lip.json</s> takes precedence; <s id="2">_timestamps.pkl</s> serves only as its timing companion.

60cf170846bfd58e380fb41085bdf606b3720b25.source: 关联成功后会看到真实层名。例子中 word、phone 都已显示，word 有 22 个候选片段。批量切分前还要检查其他文件。
60cf170846bfd58e380fb41085bdf606b3720b25.translation: Successful association shows the actual tier names. This example displays word and phone, with 22 candidate intervals in word. Check the other files before batch segmentation.

e4275cc55f6bad5ba84ef0cc27794d8f369dae53.source: 同名TextGrid已关联，词层与音素层同步显示，左栏可选择切分层。
e4275cc55f6bad5ba84ef0cc27794d8f369dae53.translation: Same-name TextGrid linked, with word and phone tiers displayed together and a segmentation-tier selector on the left.

bad3777b5c12c4f0cf12f0be2ce040eceb9f10b3.source: 最大化V3句子样例工作台，中央TextGrid下拉关联真实同名文件并显示word/phone两层，左栏显示切分层与候选片段数。
bad3777b5c12c4f0cf12f0be2ce040eceb9f10b3.translation: Maximized V3 sentence-example workbench. The central TextGrid selector links the actual same-name file and displays word/phone tiers; the left shows the segmentation tier and candidate count.

549b6c273ecdefa471c3666f31e0ac8fe8267854.source: 独立关联目录会保留，即使换了音频目录。想恢复同目录匹配，点对应<s id="0">重置</s>。读取最多 10000 项、512 个目录，链接目录会跳过。
549b6c273ecdefa471c3666f31e0ac8fe8267854.translation: Independent association folders are retained even when the audio folder changes. To restore same-folder matching, click the corresponding <s id="0">Reset</s>. Reading is limited to 10000 items and 512 folders; linked directories are skipped.

d1b41689b83445f64d6bba95713fb2655ac28156.source: 旧数值 PKL 只在本机受限读取，上限 16 MB，时间伴随文件 2 MB；不会在原目录生成转换文件。网页版请使用 <s id="0">.lip.json</s>。
d1b41689b83445f64d6bba95713fb2655ac28156.translation: Legacy numeric PKL is read locally under restrictions: 16 MB for data and 2 MB for timing companions. No converted file is created in the source folder. Use <s id="0">.lip.json</s> in the web app.

f223eb62c90c5863e3ddba97cf7c104d2c9c842e.source: 唇形沿记录内的音频时间锚点、伴随时间戳和已有手动偏移对齐，旧相对时间按首点归零。<s id="0">关联成功后仍需检查同步</s>。需要调整延迟时回到唇形提取或标注页面核对偏移，记录时间范围外保持空缺。
f223eb62c90c5863e3ddba97cf7c104d2c9c842e.translation: Lip data is aligned using recorded audio-time anchors, companion timestamps, and existing manual offsets; legacy relative times start at the first point. <s id="0">Check synchronization even after successful association.</s> To adjust delay, return to Lip extraction or Annotation and check the offset. Times outside the record remain missing.

24ca07da342c2bc56005d03da4f09adb3c70404b.translation: Preview and playback controls at a glance

acab7a2199deef9f394d3ea919bdf90cc929b2b7.source: 波形、语谱图与播放声道；不改分析角色。
acab7a2199deef9f394d3ea919bdf90cc929b2b7.translation: Channel for waveform, spectrogram, and playback; analysis roles are unchanged.

b84bf77149fe66e3032dce5726e4b4a7fb0ba182.source: 减半／加倍倍率，或恢复全长。
b84bf77149fe66e3032dce5726e4b4a7fb0ba182.translation: Halves/doubles zoom, or restores full duration.

ba2101e0e79e680f22fdbcbd40291e29b4ad1056.translation: Drag across waveform or enter seconds.

b58bee493ebcf14e7719a28e5aff820e325058cb.source: 播放／暂停；有效选区中空格也可播放／停止。
b58bee493ebcf14e7719a28e5aff820e325058cb.translation: Play/pause; Space also starts/stops playback when a valid selection exists.

d8796ea8eb80398e7b0058e0b2339b52713b41b7.source: 切文件或离开时也会停止。
d8796ea8eb80398e7b0058e0b2339b52713b41b7.translation: Also stops when switching files or leaving.

4c45fc8f4bcc61dc98cc10bae2338bd7f2843da6.translation: Seeks only within the current selection.

ee6aa501667800530e4a6fa2a339d65a23f908da.translation: 0–100%; does not alter audio or results.

390bc14284aff274aabf80b2321f8588c4850dc4.source: 点击文件名，选择<s id="0">试听声道</s>；双声道录音可打开<s id="1">显示两个声道</s>核对接线。
390bc14284aff274aabf80b2321f8588c4850dc4.translation: Click a file name and select a <s id="0">Playback channel</s>. For stereo recordings, enable <s id="1">Show both channels</s> to check the connections.

809e8d3ff8855285478b97dd2686f5d71f6485e7.source: 拖选波形或输入起止秒数。点击 TextGrid 区间也能设选区，再点播放选区或按空格开始试听；再次按空格停止。输入框和普通按钮获得焦点时保留各自的键盘操作。
809e8d3ff8855285478b97dd2686f5d71f6485e7.translation: Drag across the waveform or enter start/end seconds. Clicking a TextGrid interval also sets the selection; click Play selection or press Space to listen, and press Space again to stop. Input fields and ordinary buttons retain their own keyboard behaviour while focused.

a3a17027c922f044d9ff96e1f3877816e44b039e.source: 用 <s id="0">+／−</s> 或 <s id="1">Ctrl+滚轮</s>缩放，放大后拖<s id="2">时间窗起点</s>查看别处；<s id="3">适合窗口</s>或双击恢复全长。
a3a17027c922f044d9ff96e1f3877816e44b039e.translation: Zoom with <s id="0">+ / −</s> or <s id="1">Ctrl + wheel</s>. When zoomed in, drag <s id="2">Time window start</s> to look elsewhere. <s id="3">Fit window</s> or double-click restores full duration.

458eda96d06610d9c5d3aad9e40c05ff2436530f.source: 勾选<s id="0">显示语谱图（Praat）</s>检查当前试听声道。底部的<s id="1">全部</s>恢复整段试听；分析始终读取完整 WAV。
458eda96d06610d9c5d3aad9e40c05ff2436530f.translation: Enable <s id="0">Show spectrogram (Praat)</s> to inspect the current playback channel. <s id="1">All</s> at the bottom restores full-audio playback; analysis always reads the complete WAV.

a3f37cb1bbf1c2a8443f792617318e8be8618493.source: 图中点击 zhe4 后，蓝色选区和底部时间约为 0.1248–0.26926 秒。语谱图随试听声道显示。
a3f37cb1bbf1c2a8443f792617318e8be8618493.translation: After clicking zhe4, the blue selection and bottom times are approximately 0.1248–0.26926 seconds. The spectrogram follows the playback channel.

8fd53c1e47d6c0ba14227c9308d1274b31017926.source: 点击词层区间建立试听选区，再显示当前声道的Praat语谱图。
8fd53c1e47d6c0ba14227c9308d1274b31017926.translation: Click a word-tier interval to set playback selection, then display the current channel's Praat spectrogram.

06d44ea0c557d192720f8e5e4b3eccfb49ab4191.source: 最大化V3句子样例显示真实波形与Praat灰度语谱图，底部起止时间对应点击的zhe4词层区间。
06d44ea0c557d192720f8e5e4b3eccfb49ab4191.translation: Maximized V3 sentence example with actual waveform and Praat grayscale spectrogram. Bottom start/end times match the clicked zhe4 word interval.

021908744300ac805ff5656178fe828f903c1933.source: 长 WAV 可能使用轻量预览，界面会提示原始和预览格式。<s id="0">分析与切分始终读取原 WAV</s>，不要拿预览文件代替研究输入。
021908744300ac805ff5656178fe828f903c1933.translation: Long WAV files may use a lightweight preview, with original and preview formats shown in the interface. <s id="0">Analysis and segmentation always read the original WAV.</s> Do not substitute preview files for research inputs.

78c16834458f674f5ef22feb0cb0201987249338.source: 本机预览支持原源 8–96 kHz，派生预览最多 64 MB；网页读取也限 64 MB。预览打不开时先检查格式和提示，必要时准备更短的原音频片段。
78c16834458f674f5ef22feb0cb0201987249338.translation: Local preview supports source audio at 8–96 kHz, with derived previews up to 64 MB; web reading is also limited to 64 MB. If preview fails, check the format and message, and prepare a shorter original-audio segment if necessary.

dd4a5cc1eabfce0ae591f17400d45b7cb32872af.source: 音频与 EGG 联合分析

375d4ebef46f131eed5e9cbb7a4e83db7812af91.source: 联合 EGG 目前供 Windows 本机使用。普通分析默认混合全部声道；开启 EGG 后默认<s id="0">音频 2（右）／EGG 1（左）</s>。两者必须来自同步录制。<s id="1"> 试听声道与分析声道分别设置。</s>
375d4ebef46f131eed5e9cbb7a4e83db7812af91.translation: Joint EGG is currently available locally on Windows. Ordinary analysis mixes all channels by default. Enabling EGG defaults to <s id="0">Audio 2 (right) / EGG 1 (left)</s>; both must come from synchronized recording. <s id="1">Playback and analysis channels are configured separately.</s>

eea117b4be9b2f81cfc45270d48a291c06640752.source: 联合 EGG 的默认设置

ffd8a4f9f25289c05e4e86a61df49898c9733801.source: 开启后音频 2／EGG 1，试听另外设置。
ffd8a4f9f25289c05e4e86a61df49898c9733801.translation: When enabled: Audio 2 / EGG 1; configure playback separately.

f266317844d632abcb2c43dee830353a8f14bdd8.source: 单声道只计算声学，跳过 EGG。
f266317844d632abcb2c43dee830353a8f14bdd8.translation: Mono files compute acoustics only and skip EGG.

96fd3fb4e0b0acfd37a75daa00a57e04b22c2fc0.source: 可交换音频 1／EGG 2 或音频 2／EGG 1。
96fd3fb4e0b0acfd37a75daa00a57e04b22c2fc0.translation: Switch between Audio 1 / EGG 2 and Audio 2 / EGG 1.

e937055e4a33934d74617da61fb2b0157e92e545.source: 独立周期模式也保留主表和原周期。
e937055e4a33934d74617da61fb2b0157e92e545.translation: Independent-cycle mode also retains the main table and raw cycles.

43efa7b1438e146241633ab5d827481a801d8649.source: 仅主表插值模式显示，<s id="0">0 关闭</s>。
43efa7b1438e146241633ab5d827481a801d8649.translation: Shown only for main-table interpolation; <s id="0">0 disables it</s>.

b12f7da9ead2607aeacd2a93e9fe4a97d2ee3234.translation: Expand to configure the items below.

8fc1f22ecf3ae1516690b176ad3472eea86aeed9.source: <s id="0">须低于该 WAV 采样率的一半</s>。
8fc1f22ecf3ae1516690b176ad3472eea86aeed9.translation: <s id="0">Must be below half this WAV's sample rate.</s>

3249ec40f54d66e7df7368bec114d1b5707944b1.source: 可选比例阈值，检测接触建立。
3249ec40f54d66e7df7368bec114d1b5707944b1.translation: Relative threshold is also available; detects contact establishment.

953fbeb211afc95ce10e7ea019bf6b6afcbfb0fa.source: 可选最大斜率，检测去接触。
953fbeb211afc95ce10e7ea019bf6b6afcbfb0fa.translation: Maximum slope is also available; detects decontacting.

db1d32161b57d42e45b92fcdadd11d71f6f1313e.source: 关闭后才显示手动峰／谷突出度。
db1d32161b57d42e45b92fcdadd11d71f6f1313e.translation: Manual peak/valley prominence appears only when disabled.

0879938d613f82d687e44242a366a83a055cf72d.source: EGG 检测用，独立于声学阈值。
0879938d613f82d687e44242a366a83a055cf72d.translation: Used for EGG detection, independently of the acoustic threshold.

90e06af858f1abda2019f86ad77d6294d91eff6e.source: 超过此间隔不连线，也不跨无效周期。
90e06af858f1abda2019f86ad77d6294d91eff6e.translation: Does not connect across a larger gap or invalid cycles.

1c0621620461c0c3a217915ca198d19e66666a90.source: 计算 GCI F0 派生声学参数
1c0621620461c0c3a217915ca198d19e66666a90.translation: Compute acoustic parameters derived from GCI F0

4cc10bbbdf0187ad4e6a94dde3ead6c38bc5b3ac.source: 新增(gF0)谐波、幅值差、CPP、HNR、SHR、Slope，保留原列。
4cc10bbbdf0187ad4e6a94dde3ead6c38bc5b3ac.translation: Adds (gF0) harmonics, amplitude differences, CPP, HNR, SHR, and Slope, retaining existing columns.

f34ff2207a8d0e07304763e93a92a4bcf19c9b20.source: 先试听确认双声道里哪条是声音、哪条是 EGG，再开启<s id="0">联合计算 EGG</s>。核对<s id="1">默认音频声道</s>；接线不同的文件用<s id="2">当前文件声道</s>交换角色，<s id="3">跟随默认</s>恢复默认接线。
f34ff2207a8d0e07304763e93a92a4bcf19c9b20.translation: Listen first to identify audio and EGG channels, then enable <s id="0">Compute EGG jointly</s>. Check <s id="1">Default audio channel</s>; for differently wired files, swap roles using <s id="2">Current file channels</s>. <s id="3">Use default</s> restores default wiring.

4d2af764f2b3863ee171427e4aa400b7f39fcf2c.source: 选择<s id="0">EGG 参数表</s>。想与声学曲线按帧对照，可用默认插值到主表；只看原周期则选独立表。
4d2af764f2b3863ee171427e4aa400b7f39fcf2c.translation: Choose the <s id="0">EGG parameter table</s> format. The default main-table interpolation supports frame-by-frame comparison with acoustic curves; choose a separate table to inspect raw cycles only.

cef624b84477fda7d02c562df78e58389d0c1769.source: 联合EGG的默认音频2/EGG1与插值主表模式，试听声道单独选择。
cef624b84477fda7d02c562df78e58389d0c1769.translation: Joint EGG defaults to Audio 2 / EGG 1 and main-table interpolation; playback channel is selected separately.

bb881dbb4edc937eb3eec45bb43d7ac04a9bd99e.source: 最大化V3真实双声道EGG样例，左栏开启联合计算EGG、默认音频声道2、EGG声道1，保存方式为插值主表并保留周期表。
bb881dbb4edc937eb3eec45bb43d7ac04a9bd99e.translation: Maximized V3 stereo EGG example, with joint EGG enabled on the left, audio channel 2, EGG channel 1, and main-table interpolation retaining the cycle table.

953f85f477eb4962140517eedd1ebd2efa8a9251.source: 改成<s id="0">原始周期独立表（同一文件）</s>后，CQ／SQ 不插入主表，两种形式都保留原周期。展开<s id="1">EGG 计算设置</s>，核对高低通、事件方法和阈值。
953f85f477eb4962140517eedd1ebd2efa8a9251.translation: Selecting <s id="0">Separate raw cycle table (same file)</s> excludes CQ/SQ from the main table. Both formats retain raw cycles. Expand <s id="1">EGG calculation settings</s> and check filters, event methods, and thresholds.

3a22cabdc3da3598bf02e5b53fabf1cfdb3e0b07.source: 需要以 GCI 基频计算声学列时，勾选<s id="0">计算 GCI F0 派生声学参数</s>，会新增带 (gF0) 后缀的列。
3a22cabdc3da3598bf02e5b53fabf1cfdb3e0b07.translation: To compute acoustic columns using GCI fundamental frequency, enable <s id="0">Compute acoustic parameters derived from GCI F0</s>. This adds columns with the (gF0) suffix.

e64ede8c0187cb6d12af4e4dfc89dd968012e00d.source: 原始周期独立表模式下展开EGG计算设置，可单独启用GCI F0派生参数。
e64ede8c0187cb6d12af4e4dfc89dd968012e00d.translation: EGG calculation settings expanded in separate raw-cycle-table mode, with GCI F0-derived parameters enabled independently.

8435d0e6de847fcc0a474d1a1332376026980020.source: 最大化V3双声道EGG工作台左栏显示高低通、GCI/GOI方法、突出度、静音阈值、最大插值间隔及已启用的gF0派生设置。
8435d0e6de847fcc0a474d1a1332376026980020.translation: Maximized V3 stereo EGG workbench. The left shows filters, GCI/GOI methods, prominence, silence threshold, maximum interpolation gap, and enabled gF0-derived settings.

d862ad6e1e9014664ffb6ab95badca66ee162d93.source: 音频分析声道与 EGG 保存方式分别选择，先核对角色再分析。
d862ad6e1e9014664ffb6ab95badca66ee162d93.translation: Choose the audio analysis channel and EGG storage format separately. Check their roles before analysis.

2755702866ffc259e35fd687fe0c3dfbcbceadd5.source: 勾选待分析文件并提交。右栏<s id="0">单个音频</s>显示当前文件的进度和阶段；要停下来，点<s id="1">取消后续处理</s>并等待状态更新。
2755702866ffc259e35fd687fe0c3dfbcbceadd5.translation: Check the files to analyse and submit. <s id="0">Single audio file</s> on the right shows the current file's progress and stage. To stop, click <s id="1">Cancel remaining processing</s> and wait for the status update.

6f96d21293c0a946573dfe81d01ac43d875d653d.source: 联合EGG正在处理，单文件进度与当前阶段持续显示，批次尚未结束。
6f96d21293c0a946573dfe81d01ac43d875d653d.translation: Joint EGG running, with file progress and current stage updating while the batch remains unfinished.

f1c6348b59659ae36e291e7fda15d63fed238f34.source: 最大化V3真实EGG任务处于运行中，右栏显示0%与100%之间的单文件进度、处理阶段和批次状态，取消后续处理仍可用。
f1c6348b59659ae36e291e7fda15d63fed238f34.translation: Maximized V3 with a real EGG task running. The right shows file progress between 0% and 100%, processing stage, and batch status. Cancel remaining processing is still available.

36e192a6537b37222b8ab61fc3a8755437958328.source: 完成后检查保存提示。例子采用原周期独立表并启用 gF0，1/1 成功，保存两份文件。到参数显示分别检查主表、周期表和缺口。
36e192a6537b37222b8ab61fc3a8755437958328.translation: Check the save notice after completion. This example uses a separate raw cycle table with gF0 enabled: 1/1 succeeds and two files are saved. Inspect the main table, cycle table, and gaps separately in Parameter display.

f8ca069f8dc1887b94d4be870d9a8f107270f97e.source: 真实联合EGG及gF0派生计算完成，原周期表与主表保存在同一组双格式文件。
f8ca069f8dc1887b94d4be870d9a8f107270f97e.translation: Real joint EGG and gF0-derived computation completed; raw cycles and main parameters are retained in the same pair of output formats.

0b5111b3896de9cc5ea81baeaed4881aed573592.source: 最大化V3双声道EGG分析已完成，左栏选择原周期独立表，右栏100%及1/1已完成，顶部提示保存两个结果文件。
0b5111b3896de9cc5ea81baeaed4881aed573592.translation: Maximized V3 stereo EGG analysis completed. The left selects a separate raw cycle table; the right shows 100% and 1/1 completed, and the top reports two saved result files.

a9e32ae5e6a0f7c39910f88404176ac230f333f5.source: 时间轴要留意：<s id="0">CQ／SQ 在周期起点，gF0 在相邻 GCI 中点</s>。CQ 是接触时长占周期的比例；本应用 SQ 为（去接触时长−接触建立时长）／接触时长，可为负，避免与其他定义混用。
a9e32ae5e6a0f7c39910f88404176ac230f333f5.translation: Check the time axis: <s id="0">CQ/SQ are placed at cycle starts; gF0 at adjacent-GCI midpoints</s>. CQ is contact duration divided by period. This app's SQ is (decontacting duration − contact-establishment duration) / contact duration and may be negative. Keep it distinct from other definitions.

f33d6935439256841c6f9f621b6c51f9b145de9d.source: 插值模式主表增加 CQ、SQ 和 F0 - GCI；无效周期、长缺口和范围外保留空缺。gF0 派生仍在音频声道上计算，<s id="0">pF0</s>／<s id="1">rF0</s> 保留，Jitter／Shimmer 的方法不随之改变。
f33d6935439256841c6f9f621b6c51f9b145de9d.translation: Interpolation adds CQ, SQ, and F0 - GCI to the main table; invalid cycles, long gaps, and out-of-range times remain missing. gF0-derived measures still use the audio channel, <s id="0">pF0</s>/<s id="1">rF0</s> remain, and Jitter/Shimmer methods are unchanged.

65afa1c94fc4932ca8149f5bef19a146cfc901d2.source: 按 TextGrid 切分音频和参数
65afa1c94fc4932ca8149f5bef19a146cfc901d2.translation: Split audio and parameters by TextGrid

75b6d5ce5b6d8c9ae520fbfca8365ec8786882f1.translation: TextGrid segmentation options at a glance

69171fbe17a4499896dd772ed2a36b57001e9745.translation: Batch matching uses the tier name.

79281bac37fe335074257af92527451b9effbae7.source: 关闭只切 WAV，开启后选来源。
79281bac37fe335074257af92527451b9effbae7.translation: Off splits WAV only; when on, choose a source.

4009158b04f55db491d4cfea67f75a0587078426.source: 需要对应原 WAV 的成功分析。
4009158b04f55db491d4cfea67f75a0587078426.translation: Requires successful analysis of the original WAV.

8701a31795a950693e63cf70be5bfa0daa2e193c.source: 每份 WAV 都要明确选表。
8701a31795a950693e63cf70be5bfa0daa2e193c.translation: Explicitly select a table for every WAV.

ef16796fdc25adfc2a83383405ddbad6c2aa9483.translation: Save audio segments from current tier

a7c53520909935c3332bc30a1b8c553e3a1cf98a.source: 有勾选切勾选项，无勾选切当前文件。
a7c53520909935c3332bc30a1b8c553e3a1cf98a.translation: Splits checked files if any; otherwise the current file.

e33750d34a3191db4ab8f3871ebd8b8c509fe498.source: 点击原 WAV，确认 TextGrid 下拉框和标签时间。没有层可选时，先关联有效 TextGrid。
e33750d34a3191db4ab8f3871ebd8b8c509fe498.translation: Click the original WAV and check the TextGrid selector and label times. If no tier is available, associate a valid TextGrid first.

a2412099df587ac17f984b714b99f6cdd2569aaf.source: 在左栏<s id="0">TextGrid切分层</s>选目标层，检查候选数。空白、sil、eps、<sil>、<eps> 不导出。
a2412099df587ac17f984b714b99f6cdd2569aaf.translation: Select the target <s id="0">TextGrid segmentation tier</s> on the left and check the candidate count. Blank, sil, eps, <sil>, and <eps> intervals are not exported.

c21cf263efd1caf8d23ffda0b231dbff5db6e95a.source: 勾选要切的文件。<s id="0">无勾选时只切当前预览，有勾选时切全部勾选项</s>。
c21cf263efd1caf8d23ffda0b231dbff5db6e95a.translation: Check the files to split. <s id="0">With no checks, only the current preview is split; otherwise all checked files are split.</s>

adf66a9637fd7a40506a29ba331d358abdc64eda.source: 保持<s id="0">同时切分参数结果</s>关闭，点<s id="1">保存当前层切分音频</s>。每份 WAV 都要有 TextGrid，批量按相同层名切分。
adf66a9637fd7a40506a29ba331d358abdc64eda.translation: Keep <s id="0">Also split parameter results</s> disabled and click <s id="1">Save audio segments from current tier</s>. Every WAV needs a TextGrid; batch segmentation uses matching tier names.

e67f14a3006dfeac179df4658f4ab8cade5e35d1.source: 查看本次 <s id="0">TextGrid切分</s>记录和保存提示。保存回音频目录后列表会刷新，也可手动点<s id="1">刷新列表</s>。
e67f14a3006dfeac179df4658f4ab8cade5e35d1.translation: Check the <s id="0">TextGrid segmentation</s> record and save notice. Saving back to the audio folder refreshes the list; you can also click <s id="1">Refresh list</s> manually.

3e1253413315fc661a056ceefadff3b4c2568788.source: <s id="0">批量切分时，每份勾选文件都要有关联。</s> 图中单音节缺 TextGrid，顶部点名该文件，这次还没有提交。
3e1253413315fc661a056ceefadff3b4c2568788.translation: <s id="0">Every checked file needs an association for batch segmentation.</s> The monosyllabic file shown lacks a TextGrid; the top names it, and nothing has been submitted.

c80340bfa136ebef308b7528a545e31385154ad2.source: 批量切分中的一份WAV未关联TextGrid，提交被阻止并点名该文件。
c80340bfa136ebef308b7528a545e31385154ad2.translation: One WAV in batch segmentation has no TextGrid association; submission is blocked and names the file.

e7e2ff28b20c9a6e0f39ac8b449e0a4c0cfc355c.source: 最大化V3工作台仍显示当前句子的标注层，顶部提示single-syllable.wav尚未关联TextGrid，切分任务尚未提交。
e7e2ff28b20c9a6e0f39ac8b449e0a4c0cfc355c.translation: Maximized V3 workbench still showing the current sentence's tiers. The top reports that single-syllable.wav has no TextGrid; segmentation has not been submitted.

e7979fdde2943fa3ab49418d8ff891003d6dcfe9.source: 给提示中的 WAV 关联正确 TextGrid，或取消它的勾选，再点<s id="0">保存当前层切分音频</s>。
e7979fdde2943fa3ab49418d8ff891003d6dcfe9.translation: Associate the named WAV with its correct TextGrid or uncheck it, then click <s id="0">Save audio segments from current tier</s> again.

a21e54909b10d867859cc5d29a54f33d2e6ac0b0.source: 目标层区间须顺序正确、不重叠，带标签的片段不能越出 WAV。缺层或无效区间会让该文件失败，其他项继续。导出保留原采样率和声道。
a21e54909b10d867859cc5d29a54f33d2e6ac0b0.translation: Target intervals must be ordered and nonoverlapping, with labelled intervals inside the WAV. Missing tiers or invalid intervals fail that file while other items continue. Export retains source sample rate and channels.

2ee798189f5423b1253bced7c73de037fb34c8cc.source: 从最近一次同源完整结果切参数
2ee798189f5423b1253bced7c73de037fb34c8cc.translation: Split parameters from the latest complete same-source results

832b9fc56cd2009294d02e0b4d834dec6630de2e.source: 先在本应用完成原 WAV 的参数分析，保留完整成功记录，原音频内容不要更换。
832b9fc56cd2009294d02e0b4d834dec6630de2e.translation: First analyse the original WAV in this app and retain a complete successful record. Do not replace the original audio contents.

959d0817e014fe79654db3e340eec2251d3442c2.source: 勾选<s id="0">同时切分参数结果</s>，参数来源保持<s id="1">本应用最近一次同源完整结果</s>，再按前述步骤切分。
959d0817e014fe79654db3e340eec2251d3442c2.translation: Enable <s id="0">Also split parameter results</s>, keep the source as <s id="1">Latest complete results from the same source in this app</s>, then follow the segmentation steps above.

00c8e0c652ec699dfecc1382521ec44d2e0f47bf.source: 同时切分参数结果时，默认选择本应用最近一次同源完整结果。
00c8e0c652ec699dfecc1382521ec44d2e0f47bf.translation: Splitting parameter results defaults to the latest complete same-source result in this app.

168984719dbbcc20e39b1fc6bac60d41af2b158b.source: 最大化V3句子样例工作台，左栏同时切分参数结果已勾选，来源为最近同源完整结果，下方提示保留原帧和时间。
168984719dbbcc20e39b1fc6bac60d41af2b158b.translation: Maximized V3 sentence example with parameter splitting checked on the left and latest same-source complete results selected. The note below explains that original frames and times are retained.

77c1e099c87c765858286c610139955c67286719.source: 没有可用同源结果时，会提示数量并只切 WAV；来源不一致时先重新分析。
77c1e099c87c765858286c610139955c67286719.translation: Without usable same-source results, a count is shown and only WAV is split. If provenance differs, reanalyse first.

87eb5762c81eaeff8ae694db6dfb248fc22e85e3.source: 检查每段的 WAV、XLSX 和 SQLite，以及表中的 <s id="0">Time_s</s>、<s id="1">Source_Time_s</s>。
87eb5762c81eaeff8ae694db6dfb248fc22e85e3.translation: Check each segment's WAV, XLSX, and SQLite, including <s id="0">Time_s</s> and <s id="1">Source_Time_s</s> in the tables.

19f3aef957d30f27db688a9768973f6f1aaf63a9.source: 例子按 word 切出 22 段并连同参数保存，共 66 份文件。左栏刷新后能看到新的片段 WAV。
19f3aef957d30f27db688a9768973f6f1aaf63a9.translation: This example splits word into 22 segments and saves their parameters, producing 66 files. The refreshed list shows the new segment WAVs.

2b377a61964e21bdcb9fbd5fa60e178f4c880dca.source: 同源音频及参数切分完成；自动刷新后的列表显示导出片段，批次记录已完成。
2b377a61964e21bdcb9fbd5fa60e178f4c880dca.translation: Same-source audio and parameter segmentation completed. The automatically refreshed list shows exported segments and the batch is marked complete.

c3586200e6ba41f4b6172479bc7f4f5817fc8e0c.source: 最大化V3句子样例切分结果，左侧出现word层各标注片段WAV，中央保留原句标注，右侧TextGrid切分成功并有保存数量提示。
c3586200e6ba41f4b6172479bc7f4f5817fc8e0c.translation: Maximized V3 sentence-segmentation result: word-tier segment WAVs appear on the left, original annotations remain in the centre, and successful TextGrid segmentation and saved-file counts appear on the right.

143dd5bcf18521a8600a0f980e9cea43a4cd578b.source: 例如 <s id="0">speech-sentence_word_cun2_1.774_1.949_0009.wav</s>，包含原名、层名、标签、起止时间和原区间序号。末尾序号可能因空白或静音而不连续。
143dd5bcf18521a8600a0f980e9cea43a4cd578b.translation: For example, <s id="0">speech-sentence_word_cun2_1.774_1.949_0009.wav</s> includes original name, tier, label, start/end times, and original interval index. Indexes may be nonconsecutive because of blank or silent intervals.

c1b5270727e0d887f3c347264b28f0fc4179e914.source: <s id="0">参数切分只截原有行，不重新估计或插值。</s> <s id="1">Time_s</s> 相对片段实际首样本，<s id="2">Source_Time_s</s> 保留原音频时间；首帧可晚于 0，没有帧时记录 <s id="3">no_frames</s>。
c1b5270727e0d887f3c347264b28f0fc4179e914.translation: <s id="0">Parameter segmentation only selects existing rows, without re-estimation or interpolation.</s> <s id="1">Time_s</s> is relative to the segment's actual first sample; <s id="2">Source_Time_s</s> retains original-audio time. The first frame may be later than 0; no frames is recorded as <s id="3">no_frames</s>.

cac714acbe3f196f5c081be5b6fce15dd03b371f.source: EGG 周期按 GCI 起点归属片段，跨结尾的周期保留原终点，时间可能超过片段 WAV 长度。没有周期数据时只保留表头。
cac714acbe3f196f5c081be5b6fce15dd03b371f.translation: EGG cycles belong to a segment by their GCI start. A cycle spanning the end retains its original endpoint, which may exceed segment WAV duration. With no cycle data, only the table header is retained.

2646cc9a9884be61abb7ce3e63d0c65059dfebdf.source: 指定来源未核实的历史参数表
2646cc9a9884be61abb7ce3e63d0c65059dfebdf.translation: Specify a historical table with unverified provenance

f2d6ecdbf3f30e65d8c60d828d6ae6081265404c.source: 准备对应完整 WAV 的<s id="0">单表</s> XLSX、<s id="1">.ptb.sqlite</s> 或 <s id="2">.ptb.sqlite3</s>。本机放音频／TextGrid目录，网页先上传再刷新。
f2d6ecdbf3f30e65d8c60d828d6ae6081265404c.translation: Prepare a <s id="0">single-sheet</s> XLSX, <s id="1">.ptb.sqlite</s>, or <s id="2">.ptb.sqlite3</s> for the complete WAV. Place it in the audio/TextGrid folder locally, or upload and refresh on the web.

3a4d9b859d32af6d3bfc994e4ab8e1490c27306a.source: 开启<s id="0">同时切分参数结果</s>，来源改为<s id="1">指定历史参数表（来源未核实）</s>。
3a4d9b859d32af6d3bfc994e4ab8e1490c27306a.translation: Enable <s id="0">Also split parameter results</s> and change the source to <s id="1">Choose historical parameter table (source unverified)</s>.

51c7e2f092cd32b09340125222b7223622b15533.source: 逐个点击待切 WAV，在<s id="0">历史参数表</s>下拉中选择它的完整表，同名也要明确选择。
51c7e2f092cd32b09340125222b7223622b15533.translation: Click each WAV to split and select its complete table in <s id="0">Historical parameter table</s>. Explicit selection is required even for same-name files.

80bfb1ee8e5352871e90feeb2aa65fd96166d9cf.source: 核对 <s id="0">Time_s</s> 有限、非递减、位于完整音频内，且没有 <s id="1">Source_Time_s</s>，再提交并检查结果。
80bfb1ee8e5352871e90feeb2aa65fd96166d9cf.translation: Check that <s id="0">Time_s</s> is finite, nondecreasing, and within the complete audio, and that <s id="1">Source_Time_s</s> is absent. Then submit and inspect results.

326bca163ee2143cdbc9c5a82debdf0188983342.source: 下拉框仍是<s id="0">未指定</s>时会停止提交，提示哪份 WAV 尚未明确关联历史表。
326bca163ee2143cdbc9c5a82debdf0188983342.translation: If the selector remains <s id="0">Not specified</s>, submission stops and identifies the WAV without an explicit historical-table association.

32ab2addb39a8bfcb815834a701faa5203b88b4e.source: 历史参数来源尚未逐文件关联时停止提交，并提示先明确选择对应表。
32ab2addb39a8bfcb815834a701faa5203b88b4e.translation: Submission stops when historical tables have not been linked per file, prompting explicit selection.

da897de5582cfb462c3c9452ca36d44ef03f4ba8.source: 最大化V3工作台左栏为指定历史参数表模式，历史表下拉仍未指定，顶部提示speech-sentence.wav尚未明确关联历史参数表。
da897de5582cfb462c3c9452ca36d44ef03f4ba8.translation: Maximized V3 workbench in historical-table mode. The selector remains unspecified; the top reports that speech-sentence.wav has no explicit historical-table association.

b4a42cbf5b7be5cabbb24f8587f967ea4b8b34c0.source: 选准表再提交。若不能确定表与音频对应，先重新分析原 WAV，使用默认同源结果更稳妥。
b4a42cbf5b7be5cabbb24f8587f967ea4b8b34c0.translation: Select the correct table, then submit. If its correspondence to the audio is uncertain, reanalyse the original WAV and use the default same-source results.

d6e28efc954ac089602180a0ece6d1e9db0873dd.source: 历史表只能由使用者确认来源。支持 XLSX 单工作表或 SQLite 普通 params 表，不支持公式、外链、重复表头、CSV 或新多表 XLSX。上限 16 MB、20 万单元格、32 MB 解压 XML；新多表用默认同源入口。
d6e28efc954ac089602180a0ece6d1e9db0873dd.translation: Only the user can verify a historical table's source. Single-sheet XLSX and ordinary SQLite params tables are supported; formulas, external links, duplicate headers, CSV, and new multisheet XLSX are not. Limits are 16 MB, 200 thousand cells, and 32 MB of decompressed XML. Use the default same-source path for new multisheet results.

c98595d55232b41a0356fac2db7a709f45f5ea46.source: 本机批次结束后自动保存成功项，目标是<s id="0">提交时</s>选定的目录。后改目录不会转移这次自动保存，可从处理记录手动另存。
c98595d55232b41a0356fac2db7a709f45f5ea46.translation: After a local batch finishes, successful items save automatically to the folder selected <s id="0">at submission</s>. Changing folders later does not redirect that save; manually save elsewhere from processing records.

The table retains display names and keys for searching and checking. <s id="0">pF0</s> comes from Praat and <s id="1">rF0</s> from REAPER; suffixes on comparable measures identify the fundamental-frequency source.

43b9c944ed8fed22e7bfb130015c3dd68dee01ca.translation: In this app: outer-lip width / facial width.
